# Faster Depannage Takeldienst

> Faster Depannage Takeldienst (also known as Takeldienst Faster) is a small, independent 24/7 towing, roadside assistance (depannage / pechverhelping) and vehicle transport service based in Kiel, Antwerp, Belgium. It works mainly in Antwerp city and its districts (Hoboken, Kiel, Wilrijk, Berchem, Deurne, Merksem, Borgerhout, Ekeren, Linkeroever) and the surrounding municipalities, and also across Flanders. It also arranges national and international vehicle transport and repatriation.

Key facts (as stated on the website):

- Business name: Faster Depannage Takeldienst
- Telephone (24/7, also WhatsApp): +32 3 375 67 37 (written locally as 03.375.67.37)
- Email: faster24eu@gmail.com
- Address / base: De Bosschaertstraat 248, 2020 Antwerpen (Kiel), Belgium
- Website: https://takeldienst-depannage.com/ (formerly takeldienstfaster.be)
- Availability: reachable by phone 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
- How to request help: call +32 3 375 67 37 (fastest) or send a WhatsApp message with your location, the make and model of the vehicle, the destination and what happened
- Pricing: there is no fixed public price. The price is discussed and agreed on the phone before the tow truck sets off; it only changes if the actual situation or distance is clearly different from what was described
- Response time: depends on location, traffic, demand and urgency; for urgent call-outs around 30 minutes is often possible, but this is not guaranteed
- Languages of the website: Dutch (full site); French and English for the homepage, Antwerpen and Gent; Polish for the homepage
- Services: roadside assistance (flat battery, jump start, flat tyre, starting problems, locked out), towing and recovery after breakdown, accident or fire, transport of non-running vehicles, car transport to a garage, home, buyer, seller or the port of Antwerp, vans and light commercial vehicles under 3.5 tonnes, motorcycles and scooters, forklifts and machines, international vehicle transport and repatriation (e.g. France, Spain, Germany, Italy, Austria, Switzerland, United Kingdom, Ireland)
- Not offered: towing of vehicles removed by the city or police for illegal parking (that is an administrative tow; contact the authority that ordered it)

## Main pages

- [Homepage](https://takeldienst-depannage.com/): who Faster is, services, how it works, service area, FAQ
- [Takeldienst & depannage Antwerpen](https://takeldienst-depannage.com/takeldienst/antwerpen/): Antwerp city, the Ring, Kennedy tunnel, districts and port transport
- [Takeldienst Hoboken](https://takeldienst-depannage.com/takeldienst/hoboken/): Hoboken (2660), next to the Kiel base
- [Werkgebied (service area overview)](https://takeldienst-depannage.com/takeldienst/): all areas with a dedicated page
- [Diensten (services)](https://takeldienst-depannage.com/diensten/): roadside assistance, towing, transport, vans, machines, international
- [Zwaar transport](https://takeldienst-depannage.com/diensten/zwaar-transport/): heavier and special transport
- [Depannage vrachtwagen](https://takeldienst-depannage.com/depannage-vrachtwagen/): trucks and heavier vehicles
- [Dringend een takeldienst](https://takeldienst-depannage.com/takeldienst-dringend/): urgent help
- [Kennedytunnel & Ring](https://takeldienst-depannage.com/takeldienst/kennedytunnel-ring/): breakdowns on the Antwerp Ring (R1) and in the Kennedy tunnel
- [Depannage haven Antwerpen](https://takeldienst-depannage.com/depannage-haven-antwerpen/): breakdowns in the port and vehicle transport to and from port terminals
- [Takeldienst Antwerpen prijs](https://takeldienst-depannage.com/takeldienst-antwerpen-prijs/): what determines the price of a tow (no fixed public price)
